Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

You offer cost transparency alongside an emphasis on continuing the relationship—it sounds like a sustainable renewal matters to you. We value that continuity and would welcome your cost breakdown in XLSX to work from a shared understanding of the underlying elements. How could a longer agreement give you the certainty to improve the price sustainably?

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 10%, PPI-C2815 65%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C2815 +0.6%), your cost increase comes to about +0.6% of the price, not +13.0%. Our demand forecast for Deep groove ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 is up +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09). That supports a price of about EUR 4.41. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.83 per unit, 45 days payment, 36 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. 

We acknowledge your proposal for a 36-month agreement and the extended payment terms of 45 days. Reflecting the longer contract term, we can revise our offer to a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Please understand that our detailed cost breakdowns are proprietary and cannot be shared. 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

Thank you for revising your unit price to reflect the longer contract term and for retaining the proposed payment terms. We respect the proprietary nature of your detailed calculation; could you share a summarised cost breakdown in XLSX format, excluding confidential details, to help us review the pricing elements and conclude the renewal discussion?

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +0.6%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.87 per unit, 30 days payment, 36 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and the adjustment to 30 days payment terms. 

In response, we can offer a price of EUR 4.88 per unit for a 36-month contract with 30 days payment. Our actual Angebot is a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Please note that we do not provide detailed cost breakdowns or XLSX files, as our internal calculations remain strictly confidential. You might ask: Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Thank you for your trust in our service and our range. We look forward to continuing our successful partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

Thank you for your revised offer and the price adjustment linked to a longer contract term. We respect the confidentiality of your detailed calculations and suggest keeping the remaining discussion focused on finalising the unit price, payment terms and contract duration on a mutually workable basis.

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +0.6%. What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.89 per unit, 45 days payment, 36 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have received your updated proposal and the monthly call-off schedule. We always strive to provide you with the best possible service and range from our inventory. To support the requested 45 days payment terms for a 36-month contract, our lowest possible price is EUR 4.90 per unit. Therefore, our offer includes a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

Please note that our margin and our limits stay internal. Furthermore, our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Kindly note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
